author: 0cc4m
body: Split mode row has never been supported on Vulkan, it has always silently fallen back to split mode layer.

author: Hercules888
body:
> Split mode row has never been supported on Vulkan, it has always silently fallen back to split mode layer.

Thank you very much for your reaction. If I understand correctly, if the --split-mode parameter is set to row or to layer in the provided example, considering your feedback, this should potentially result in the same performance?

I did simulations, and have used the same command-line (as was mentioned before), with the --split-mode parameter as only difference. I ran every simulation twice (results are stable).

There is a huge difference (not only on timings but also on GPU saturation) between the 2 modes.
Am I missing something here?

Interactive simulation:
Prefill (Web UI - split-mode row run 1/2)= 57412 tokens - 57s - 1001.74 tokens/s
Prefill (Web UI - split-mode row run 2/2)= 57412 tokens - 57s - 999.39 tokens/s

Prefill (Web UI - split-mode layer run 1/2)= 57412 tokens - 1min 20s - 709.82 tokens/s
Prefill (Web UI - split-mode layer run 2/2)= 57412 tokens - 1min 20s - 712.69 tokens/s

author: 0cc4m
body: That would be because it disabled pipeline parallelism, not because it changed the split mode. We're working on making that work better, but it's not done yet.

author: Hercules888
body: Thanks again for pointing out the root cause! I saw in the code that one of the conditions that allows to influence pipeline-parallellism is actually "model.has_tensor_overrides()", so I now use split-mode layer, and define a dummy override (--override-tensor "DummyIDontExist=CPU"), and I get my performance back in the latest builds.

author: Neutralized
body:
I always used tensor split row on dual AMD GPU's and it always worked, i got better split between both GPU's memory and better TG/s in dense models like Qwen 3.6 27B and now i cant run it and im getting: 

error loading model: device Vulkan0 does not support split buffers

This is a huge issue for me and my setup, split mode layer is splitting vram differently and i cant fit same context size and also it always had worse performance with dense model.
